schema.text: What would make riding a motorcycle or scooter safer or easier for you? (Select all that apply)

en.#What would make riding a motorcycle or: What would make riding a motorcycle or scooter safer or easier for you? (Select all that apply)

it.#What would make riding a motorcycle or: Cosa renderebbe per te più sicuro o più facile andare in moto o in scooter? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#More motorcycle and scooter parking: Più parcheggi per moto e scooter
it.#Lanes free from parked cars: Corsie libere dalle auto in sosta

fr.#What would make riding a motorcycle or: Qu’est-ce qui rendrait vos trajets à moto ou en scooter plus sûrs ou plus faciles ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#More motorcycle and scooter parking: Plus de stationnements pour motos et scooters
fr.#Lanes free from parked cars: Des voies libres de voitures stationnées

de.#What would make riding a motorcycle or: Was würde Ihnen das Fahren mit Motorrad oder Roller sicherer oder einfacher machen? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#More motorcycle and scooter parking: Mehr Parkplätze für Motorräder und Roller

tr.#What would make riding a motorcycle or: Motosiklet veya scooter sürmeyi sizin için neler daha güvenli veya kolay hâle getirir? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#More motorcycle and scooter parking: Daha fazla motosiklet ve scooter park yeri

fa.#What would make riding a motorcycle or: چه چیزی سواری با موتور یا اسکوتر را برای شما ایمن‌تر یا آسان‌تر می‌کند؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#More motorcycle and scooter parking: پارکینگ بیشتر برای موتور و اسکوتر

hu.#What would make riding a motorcycle or: Mitől lenne biztonságosabb vagy könnyebb Önnek a motorozás vagy robogózás? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)

ar.#What would make riding a motorcycle or: ما الذي يجعل ركوب الدراجة النارية أو السكوتر أكثر أمانًا أو سهولة بالنسبة لك؟ (يمكن اختيار كل ما ينطبق)
